goal: xUnit review: fact and theory use, shared fixtures and assertions that can fail.
use: xUnit review: fact and theory use, shared fixtures and assertions that can fail. Use when xUnit tests are added or changed.

steps.note: List the test classes and their fixtures.
Check theories. Flag theories with one data row or duplicated facts.
Check fixtures. Flag shared mutable fixtures that couple tests.
Check assertions. Flag tests that assert nothing or only that no exception occurred.
Report. Each finding with file and line, the problem and the fix.
